clue.text: Vehicle that Rita constantly keeps in reverse

Rita constantly keeps a run of letters within its two words, spanning the join

explanation.surface: Someone called Rita can't stop driving backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps' picks TACONS from RiTA CONStantly; 'in reverse' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A snowcat is a tracked vehicle built for travelling over snow.

clue.text: Any number must have talked about college do

indicators.note: said out loud, the college's name gives a word spelt differently

parts.note: Eton, the famous English public school, is often called Eton College

explanation.definitionFit: To do a room or one's hair can mean to tidy it up, make it orderly.

clue.text: Lord Green interrupts Labour leader endlessly

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lord' looks like a peer; it is the exclamation. Jeremy Corbyn led Labour from 2015 to 2020.

clue.text: Energy features in fresh oil study in a monotonous way

fresh suggests the letters of oil study are made anew in another order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.walkthrough: 'fresh' rearranges OIL STUDY; 'features in' puts E inside the result.

clue.text: It's clear 5D, say, has started a battle

explanation.surface: Clearly, the prime minister in question has begun a war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is a link word. 'It's clear' is the definition, a playful description of a soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Consommé is a clarified, transparent soup, so it is something that is clear.

clue.text: Leading politician's unhappy romance

indicators.note: unhappy suggests the letters of romance are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A top politician is caught in an affair that has turned sour.
explanation.definitionFit: David Cameron was the UK prime minister from 2010 to 2016.

clue.text: A post needing some acetylene welding

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A metal post must be repaired with gas welding.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'A post needing' as the definition; 'needing' is only a link word, and 'A post' alone defines.

clue.text: Veteran EastEnders' actor named William

parts.note: William Holden was a Hollywood film star

explanation.definitionFit: Olden means old or of bygone days, as a veteran thing is long-established.

clue.text: Erasmus is at work cutting India rubbers

cutting says a letter is removed from the mix

parts.note: I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

clue.text: Wonderful place for day trip enthralling one with a spot of magic

trip suggests the letters of for day stumble into a new order

indicators.note: a spot of gives just the first letter of magic

explanation.surface: An outing to a wondrous spot entrances someone with a touch of magic.

explanation.definitionFit: Fairydom is the realm of fairies, an enchanted land of marvels.

clue.text: Superlative broad — wife, that is

parts.note: id est is the Latin for 'that is', usually written i.e.

explanation.surface: A woman is praised as the best possible spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broad' looks like slang for a woman next to 'wife'; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative form of the adjective broad is the most wide.

clue.text: Italian architect spending silver in harem

parts.note: a seraglio is the women's quarters of a Muslim palace
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.definitionFit: Sebastiano Serlio was a sixteenth-century Italian Mannerist architect and theorist.

clue.text: Supplied grass skirts to be softened

parts.note: a reed is a tall water grass
lent means provided for a time

explanation.walkthrough: 'grass skirts' reads as a hula costume, but 'skirts' is the verb meaning goes round.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to soften one's stance and become less severe.

clue.text: Sport that's not given weight and attention

indicators.note: not given says the letter for weight is left out

parts.note: to sport a hat is to wear it

explanation.surface: A sport played without weights still needs focus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sport' looks like a game; it is the verb meaning to show off a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone your ear is to pay them attention and listen.

clue.text: Tellers who deceive skinflints keeping in shape

indicators.note: keeping means holding the following phrase within

parts.note: misers are mean people who hoard money
fit and well is in form

explanation.walkthrough: 'Tellers' suggests bank clerks, which suits skinflints, but it means those who tell.
explanation.definitionFit: Misinformers give people false information, so they are deceptive informants.

clue.text: Dungeon's new arrangement of Let It Be after endless tour

indicators.note: after places the rearranged song title behind the trimmed word
endless drops both the first and final letters of tour
a new arrangement of the song title shuffles its letters

explanation.walkthrough: 'Let It Be' is a Beatles song, so 'new arrangement' sounds musical; it is the anagram signal.

clue.text: Small computer with a dry power unit

parts.note: a micro is a microcomputer
TT means teetotal, so not drinking

explanation.surface: A little laptop with a dry battery as its power supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A microwatt is a millionth of a watt, a measure of electrical power.

clue.text: Revolutionary men brought up boy in revolutionary town

indicators.note: revolutionary here means turning round, so read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.definitionFit: Rochdale is a large northern English town, birthplace of the cooperative movement.

clue.text: After college, Sally deconstructed writer using long words?

indicators.note: after puts the rearranged name behind the college

parts.note: a poly is a polytechnic, a type of college

explanation.walkthrough: 'deconstructed' sounds like literary theory, but it rearranges SALLY into SYLLA.

clue.text: Model's love for one tosspot

I is the Roman numeral for one
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

clue.text: Racially loaded, an American denied getting carried away

denied says a letter is withheld from the mix

clue.text: American hero could be worshipped shortly

indicators.note: shortly cuts the final letter off the word

parts.note: revered means deeply venerated

explanation.surface: A patriot might be adored before long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Revere made the famous midnight ride warning of British troops in 1775.

clue.text: He painted western leader embracing son

indicators.note: embracing means holding the next letter inside

parts.note: Hitler was called Führer, German for leader

explanation.surface: An artist depicted a cowboy chief hugging his son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'western' suggests a cowboy film but is just the abbreviation W.

clue.text: A number to avoid

to go round something rather than face it

clue.text: Authorised escape?

definitions.meaning: to run away fast, split as two words in British slang

clue.text: Woman takes one cat in from France

en is French for in

explanation.definitionFit: Imogen is a girl's given name, used for the heroine of Cymbeline.

indicators.note: of puts the degree holders before the circle they form

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts
a ring is a group, such as a spy ring

clue.text: Accommodation providing bed and breakfast finally served by penniless attendants
